info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Branch Operations Management API
info.description: The E-Branch Operations Management API enables businesses to efficiently perform operational actions specific to e-branch banking. This endpoint allows users to initiate various operational activities such as transaction processing, account updates, and service requests through seamless POST requests. Typical consumers include banking institutions and developers integrating e-branch functionalities into their applications. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their service delivery and operational efficiency in the digital banking landscape.

post.summary: Create an operational action for e-branch.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new operational action specific to the e-branch. It is used to manage and implement various operational changes efficiently and effectively.
